conviction_note: Q3 numbers, impairments and cash were pre-released in the 27 Oct trading update, so the release's new content is the dividend decision (net cash up from USD 59m to USD 180m, and the company's own 'will revert with a dividend plan') plus small guidance housekeeping. That gives a positive finding sum (+0.6), but a retail crowd openly expecting a dividend and seven of eleven results days falling put p_up at 50, so the scaled number is 0 on an abs move of 4.5. The two measurements disagree on purpose: the findings carry the dividend skew, p_up carries the sell-the-print history and a raised bar.

findings.finding: Net cash went from USD 59m at 30 June to about USD 180m at 30 September (cash USD 476m against USD 296m bonds) after the Mistral sale closed, and the company's own Q2 report lists high prices, Bestla progress and the Mistral closing as 'positives in the company's dividend assessments' and says it 'will revert with a dividend plan'. That makes a dividend plan in the 3 November release plausible, though not committed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: no dividend change has fallen on a results day in the observed history (the dividend was suspended earlier; the last one was NOK 1.00 per Nordnet). Results days overall: 3 up, 7 down, 1 flat out of 11, median |move| 2.2%
findings.why_not_priced: The cash number is public, but the decision is not, and nothing in the price says it has been taken. If a reinstatement were priced, OKEA would have beaten its peers into the print; instead it fell 6.5% on 2 November against 3-4.5% for Vår Energi, Aker BP and Equinor, and fell 1.4% on the trading-update day. The 20-day run-up of +16% follows Brent. Retail expectation is visible (Nordnet Social), which is why the downside of the range is wide: no dividend would disappoint an open expectation.
findings.independence: retail forum commentary on the same question, not a second fact: https://www.nordnet.no/market/stocks/17069504-okea (Nordnet Social, 2026-11-02: 'blir det avgjørende at de kommuniserer klart om utbytte')

findings.finding: The Q3 trading update attributes the Statfjord impairment to 'reduced volume estimates and increased capex', which puts a small risk on the 2027 production guide of 39-43 kboepd and on the 2026 capex range when the release updates guidance.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: the July cut to the 2026 production guide (with 2027 raised) came with a -2.2% results day; the February 2026 introduction of the 2027 guide came with +4.1%
findings.why_not_priced: The impairment money is priced (small post-tax, already disclosed), but the volume revision behind it has not yet reached a production or capex number. If the market had priced a guide trim, the trading-update day would have fallen more than 1.4% and OKEA would not have rallied to 49.90 by 30 October. It is an inference from one sentence, so it is sized small.

outside_window.finding: Talisker West PDO and first oil in H2 2027, and the Bestla start-up in early 2027: the main 2027 volume growth drivers, outside the one-session window

baseline_tension: The positive dividend finding cuts against the slightly negative priced lean (-0.82, which is only the run-up term) and against the name's habit of falling on results days; the sell-the-print history and the retail-raised bar take p_up back to 50.
language_note: Every OKEA filing (trading update, Q2 report, notices) is published in English only on NewsWeb, so the Norwegian half added nothing on the documents.

Nordnet Social (Norwegian retail forum, 2026-11-02) carried the one thing the English sources did not: an openly stated retail expectation that the Q3 report must clarify the dividend ('blir det avgjørende at de kommuniserer klart om utbytte'), plus price-target talk ('60kr kommer i morgen'). That sets the informal bar and widens the downside of the dividend finding.
The Norwegian press (dn.no paywalled, e24/Finansavisen not found) carried nothing reachable.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' and 'too small about the move': abs_move_pct raised from 4.0 to 4.5, because the dividend plan is a capital-return decision on the scale of a guidance event, the name runs at 53% realised volatility, and the pre-released period alone would argue for about 3%
'The reaction history vetoes the direction, not the size' plus 'a verified fact is not a predicted reaction': p_up moved from 51 to 50 (7 of 11 results days fell), and abs_move_pct was not cut for it

'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': confirmed that no reported-quarter finding is filed and that the impairment money is not sized; the Statfjord finding is kept only for its unpriced guidance implication
dividend finding range widened to -4/+8 to reflect the retail-raised bar; its point size stays at +1.0, so the sum is unchanged
